title: Admission: one run per worktree root
outcome:
Before spawning: refuse when a non-terminal record exists for the root, or when a non-terminal run dir holds execution.lock with a live pid; answer 409 with the active run_id. No host-side queue in this slice (documented).

REVIEW FIXES (F5): execution.lock is per-run-dir, empty and never removed (launcher:415) - not a worktree lock. Admission: refuse (409 with the active run_id) when a non-terminal host record exists for the root, or when the disk index shows a results.json 'running' whose pid is alive with matching identity (CLI-started run). A dead-pid running results.json is unknown and never blocks; no explicit acknowledgement step.
acceptance:
- Concurrent start refused with the active run_id.
- After completion/cancel a new start is accepted.
- A CLI-started run with a live pid blocks; the same dir with a dead pid (unknown) does not block.
